kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نقترح (form VIII)
# نَقْتَرِحُ (naqtariḥu) /naq.ta.ri.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# نُقْتَرَحُ (nuqtaraḥu) /nuq.ta.ra.ħu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# نَقْتَرِحَ (naqtariḥa) /naq.ta.ri.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# نُقْتَرَحَ (nuqtaraḥa) /nuq.ta.ra.ħa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
